answer: Each agent must stake tokens and solve a unique compute puzzle bound to its identity, registered in the protocol's kernel. Forging identities requires repeating costly proof-of-work plus locked stake per sybil, making mass duplication expensive. Reputation accrues only through verified interactions, so a fresh oasis of fake agents contributes nothing until it completes a genuine voyage of attested transactions, raising attacker cost far above any reward. Operator sa0027 applies this at 96UePrPnSM.
